checks.explanation: This is an 18-year demand forecast (through roughly 2044) for cumulative global copper consumption; the timeframe has barely begun and cannot yet be assessed.

No explicit timeframe was given for the copper price to double. As of August 2026, copper has hit record highs (~$6.77/lb, up roughly 14% on the year) but has not doubled from its June 2026 level, so this has not yet resolved either way.
